edges.reason: transfer() forwards to the private _transfer core
transferFrom() forwards to the private _transfer core
transferFrom() calls _approve to update the allowance
approve() calls _approve
balanceOf() calls tokenFromReflection
tokenFromReflection() reads the rate via _getRate
_getRate() derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply
_transfer finally invokes _tokenTransfer
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth before state updates
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the ETH threshold is reached
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) into contractTokenBalance
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee
_getValues calls _getTValues
_getValues calls _getRValues
_getValues reads the current rate
_takeTeam reads the current rate
manualSwap() calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance
manualSend() calls sendETHToFee with the full ETH balance
startTrading() calls factory createPair
startTrading() calls addLiquidityETH with contract ETH
startTrading() calls _approve for router spending
sendETHToFee executes the ETH transfer to _taxWallet
swapTokensForEth executes the router swap
msg.sender flows through _msgSender() into _transfer as the from address
msg.sender is passed to _approve in approve/transferFrom
_owner is set from msg.sender in the constructor and gates onlyOwner functions
manualSwap is externally callable by any msg.sender without onlyOwner and moves contract funds
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline and the call can be timed by miners
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline
transferFrom subtracts the transferred amount from _allowances via SafeMath sub
The external router swap call happens before _tokenTransfer updates balances, allowing reentry into transfer paths
Constructor assigns the hardcoded Uniswap V2 router to _uniswap
Constructor assigns _taxWallet from _msgSender()
startTrading assigns the newly created pair address to _pair

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to be forwarded from transfer into _transfer
The amount parameter of transfer is consumed by the same external entry function
The sender parameter is only used locally inside transferFrom
The amount parameter is consumed by transferFrom when deducting the allowance
The from parameter is only meaningful inside the private _transfer routine
The to parameter is only meaningful inside the private _transfer routine
The tokenAmount parameter is only consumed by swapTokensForEth
The local variable is a temporary cache of balanceOf inside _transfer
The path array is a temporary swap argument built inside swapTokensForEth
The local rate variable is a temporary copy of the value returned by _getRate
The local token amount is a temporary used only inside _getTValues arithmetic
